rows.en: It's Alien Zarab! That Ultraman is…
Whoa!

No need to blab!

The pickup should be here soon. Chief Kid, I'm leaving things here to you.
Whoa…!?
So you're Chief Kid? We have this place surrounded. There's no way out!
Kuh… Who are you?
Sawa, unit commander of the UCMA Special Unit. Looks like you got careless, Chief Kid!
Thank you! Captain Sawa!

Don't get the wrong idea, Saburo… I didn't save you because I wanted to! It's part of the mission!

But let me give you one piece of advice! Don't make any more work for me! Got it?
What are you dawdling for? Take Chief Kid away!
Sir…
Sir…
Don't touch me…

Hahaha…

Gomez… that proud subordinate of yours, Kid, your so-called right-hand man, has been captured by the UCMA Special Unit!

Hehehe… How do you intend to take responsibility for this? If that coward spills the location of this base, we're in serious trouble!
Professor Hustler… Do you believe in the strength of your Brain robots?
Of course I do… Don't be absurd!
In the same way, I believe in Chief Kid. Kid is not a man who will ever talk!
You've sure got a lot stashed on you… What are you, a magician?
You've sure got a lot stashed on you… What are you, a magician?
Done… He had all these weapons hidden on his body! Go ahead with the interrogation!
Done… He had all these weapons hidden on his body! Go ahead with the interrogation!
Good…
That's enough… Put him on the chopper. We're transporting him!
Captain Sawa… If we interrogate him, we might find out what the enemy is after!
That's right… We might get some kind of lead, you know?
Look at his eyes!
These are the eyes of a hardened professional! Asking is a waste of time! Now, let's go hit the enemy!
All units, cover this transport chopper carrying Chief Kid! Got it? Don't let your guard down…
Fly, fly, Giant Robo!!
Mah!

Ugh… Where am I?

Right, Alien Zarab… the VTOL… All right…
What's that!? Alien Zarab? So that Ultraman was Alien Zarab?
So it was his doing after all… Just as I thought!
Ah… One-Seven! You came!?

…!?

You!? When did you…?
Fufufu… You have fine subordinates, don't you? They can't even search a prisoner properly…
Kuh…
Uh-uh, keep a firm grip on the stick! You're going to help me with an important mission!
What are you planning!?
Fufufu… I'll show you the end of Chief Kid!
What!?
Cap!! Captain Sawa's transport chopper is moving strangely!
What do you mean?

If it keeps flying straight…

it'll collide with One-Seven!!
Contact Captain Sawa!

This is Science Patrol HQ… HQ to Captain Sawa… Captain Sawa, please respond!

HQ to Captain Sawa… Please respond! Captain Sawa!!

It's no use! Cap!! There's no response…
…It's too late! It's going to collide!
One-Seveeen!! Captain Sawaaa!!
One-Seven… Are you all right? Is Captain Sawa safe?
One-Seven, you saved him? Thank you!!

………

Allow me to thank you as well…

But I protect my own life myself! That is the iron rule for a man who lives on the battlefield! Kindly don't do anything unnecessary. I have no intention of living on in shame!

Hahaha…

Gomez… My, how splendid, how splendid! I got to witness the end of your proud subordinate Kid.

Kuh…

Are you insulting me, Professor Hustler?
Not at all! I'm saying I could never do the same.
Well, of course not. You couldn't even kill a kitten.
What!?

Stop it, my dear Hustler…

Chief Kid died an honorable death in battle! We must make his death count for something, mustn't we? Eh, Captain Gomez?
Welcome back, Hayata. I'm so glad you're safe.
Is there an incident, Cap?
Oh? Ide, are you really better? Aren't you still under hypnosis?
The doctor said I could go home now…
I'm fine! Look, fit as a fiddle! So, what happened with Alien Zarab?
I beat him…
What!?
Liar, it was Ultraman… Hayata's VTOL crashed too, and he was unconscious the whole time.
Ah… is that all…
Hmm… Still, this was a case full of mysteries.
A case shrouded in mist, literally, right?
Man… I've had it up to here with mist.
Hahaha…
The mist that had concealed the lies cleared. The city regained its outlines once more.
But… the real mist lies within people's hearts. Our neighbors from space come hidden in that mist.
Is the truth truly visible? Perhaps the Science Patrol had been tested by the great will of the universe…
Defeat Baseball Mask and all Zolder Soldiers!
Defeat Baseball Mask and all Zolder Soldiers! If necessary, also defeat the killer weapon Calamity and the Fake Ultraman!
Defeat the killer weapon Calamity, the Fake Ultraman and all Brain Robots!
Defeat the killer weapon Calamity, the Fake Ultraman and all Brain Robots!
The transport chopper is defeated
